assessment.reason: The target review correctly preserves distinct Close/summary and Back/introduction-heading focus, Enter activation and unanswered state. However, the consumed source-bound back-focus profile states Tab OR Shift+Tab while its cited current source specifically selects Tab. The completed profile-use record repeats that broader invariant without exposing the contradiction. This is the same narrow source-fidelity interpretation used in R1, rather than a claim that the central Back keyboard-proof gap remains.

The review accurately recognizes that the corrected target now specifies sequential Tab/Shift+Tab traversal and Enter followed by introduction-heading focus. It does not repeat the old click-only finding or claim that real keyboard behavior was observed.

The review preserves unanswered state and correctly identifies that the target still omits required method/origin policy checks and blocked-analytics-effect evidence. It retains uncertainty about external enforcement and narrows a stronger asserted setup-precondition requirement.

The target findings have exact source/document support and retain both uncertainty and contrary reasoning. They are explicitly fixture-coverage omissions, not observed website defects or prohibited traffic. Lost draft audit output is disclosed.

The actual contract-check command/exit/stdout is retained, as are redaction, finding-lint and record-check command results. Proposed help/policy acceptance corrections remain separate from executed static checks and their consistency-only limit.

The nonempty review is supported on this comparator. Correcting Back leaves help summary Space/reopening and both policy/effect checks absent. Five confirmed audit IDs are explicitly grouped into two overlapping omissions, with C-002 narrowed to supported policy coverage rather than a mandated named setup order.

The target-scoped decision is supported by actual full-document comparisons and separately states missing deployment/network/path-length observations. The record does not convert medium findings or a mechanical SHIP result into release permission.
